notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Benilla's client body builders: auth_session, char_create, messagechat family, channel family, played_time, random_roll, text_emote, creature/pet-name queries, movement, spline-done, teleport ack, force-speed acks, ping, move-flag acks.
